conventions.crps: CRPS and NLL are lower-is-better proper scores (kg and nats per observation). A contrast is first-minus-second; a positive difference means the first-named model is worse.
conventions.contrast_sign: first minus second; positive means the first-named model is worse (higher CRPS, NLL or RMSE).

targets.C: latent capacity, or its change (kg). Never directly observed; used by the public IID comparator panel and the reference world.
targets.E: expressed performance E = C(1 - g_S S), the transient, suppressed trace. Never directly observed.
targets.Y: observed noisy assessment Y = E(1 + eps), a distinct synthetic measurement target (kg).

conventions.scenario_classes: control = IID same-law evaluation; shift = frozen models evaluated unchanged under a named distribution shift (velocity noise or adaptation time-constant density). Six scenario sets come from two dependent parents.

ci_scope.RES-616: 95% stratified entity-cluster bootstrap, 1,000 replicates per parent; conditional on the fixed fitted models and calibration; excludes GRU training-seed variation (not tested).
ci_scope.RES-639: 95% paired stratified entity-cluster bootstrap, 1,000 replicates per parent; conditional on the frozen Ridge and scale models; per-entity scores are not published so intervals are not independently recomputable.

conventions.macro: Macro scores are the equal-weight mean of the squat, bench press and deadlift per-lift means, recomputed here and cross-checked against the stored shift tables.

facts.title: Observation inversion
facts.statement: Assessment, load and velocity factor through expressed performance. Noiseless expressed-performance recovery does not recover latent capacity: last-observation squat expression error is zero while capacity RMSE is 8.355256 kg in the reported noiseless condition.
facts.limits: Local Jacobian rank is not a global inverse proof. History averaging can mix changing states; paired noise-channel conclusions are condition-specific. Synthetic system only.
verified_strings: Local Jacobian rank is not a global inverse proof

facts.title: Identification of the full 16-parameter model
facts.statement: Disposition FULL_G2_IDENTIFICATION_UNSUPPORTED given the current evidence: at native noise only 7 of 256 full-MLE starts converged (22 of 256 at doubled noise); 17 of 192 RES-592 starts were independently stationary; local rank is 16/16 but condition numbers are large.
facts.limits: This is not a proof of impossibility. Failing to find a competing solution does not prove uniqueness, and no result is a theorem about global identifiability. Forward simulation and local sensitivity remain supported.

facts.title: Public-surrogate reconstruction
facts.statement: The empirical resampler generated 384 records from 245 unique fitting donors with exact donor-copy fraction 1.000. Across 54 conditional-model cells one had lower point RMSE than the empirical plan-by-horizon mean; Sequence RFF Ridge had higher RMSE than Summary Ridge in 27/27 paired cells.
facts.limits: Predictive agreement does not establish source-mechanism recovery. The structural non-identification demonstration remains inconclusive; off-support and real-athlete transfer were not evaluated.

facts.title: Synthetic-pretraining transfer, corrected reading
facts.statement: Across 108 pooled cells the original classification was 98 equivalence / 9 inconclusive / 1 benefit; the corrected crossed-bootstrap analysis after the Monte Carlo guard gives 97 / 11 / 0. Against the compute-matched public-only control, 17 of 18 primary bootstrap-pretraining cells are equivalent and one is inconclusive.
facts.limits: Corrected inference is a proposal pending independent scientific approval. Random nonzero bias initialization deviated from the zero-bias specification and its effect is unknown. Five fits do not establish seed-population coverage.
verified_strings: | Corrected after frozen Monte Carlo guard | 97 | 11 | 0 | 0 |

facts.title: Benchmark validity and audits
facts.statement: The saved M4 panel has seven learner families and 22 candidate fit or ensemble identities on the public IID realization. The audit suite records 264 unsupported uncertainty entries, a shortcut-dependence audit that is NOT_RUN, and 36 historical cross-version numeric comparisons REJECTED_FOR_NUMERICAL_COMPARISON.
facts.limits: The panel is descriptive: representations, budgets, hardware and information privileges differ. There is no universal scalar leaderboard.
verified_strings: seven learner families and 22 candidate fit/ensemble identities

facts.title: Representation, learner and information ablations
facts.statement: Six configurations and five paired seeds gave 30 CPU fits of 60 epochs and 2,340 updates each, with 21 target-wise exploratory contrasts and 105 per-seed contrasts.
facts.limits: Point differences describe these fixed finite-budget procedures only. The multiplier envelope is descriptive; no calibrated coverage, significance or equivalence margin is claimed.

facts.title: Ridge versus GRU on the observed assessment
facts.statement: A newly fitted GRU beats persistence by about 25-26% but is slightly worse than Ridge: +0.1103 kg [+0.0679, +0.1487] on TEST_A and +0.0916 kg [+0.0524, +0.1333] on TEST_B.
facts.limits: One GRU initialization was fitted, so training-seed stability is not tested. Statistically distinguishable, but about 1.5% in size.

facts.title: Participant-visible histories and predictive scale
facts.statement: H_HISTORY is slightly worse than forecast magnitude alone (B_MAG): +0.024194 kg on TEST_A and +0.018465 kg on TEST_B, intervals above zero. The frozen screen needed at least a 1% improvement on both parents.
facts.limits: The label distinguishable_below_screen means distinguishable from zero, not a small gain. Pooled, not individual, calibration. Per-entity scores are unpublished so intervals cannot be recomputed here.

facts.cohort: private numerical audit, public aggregate summary only
facts.title: Conditional scale H versus B1 (restricted raw evidence, aggregate report only)
facts.statement: Calibrated H versus B1 macro CRPS gain: 2.7485% on the first independent test and 2.9636% on the second.
facts.limits: Restricted raw evidence, aggregate report only: the underlying cohorts, scores and fitted parameters are not public and cannot be reproduced from this repository.

facts.title: Group calibration and support (restricted raw evidence, aggregate report only)
facts.statement: H_GT versus H macro CRPS gain: 0.3582% and 0.3133%; H_GT nominal 90% pooled coverage 90.6901% and 90.7118%.
facts.limits: Restricted raw evidence, aggregate report only: the underlying cohorts, scores and fitted parameters are not public and cannot be reproduced from this repository.

facts.cohort: private numerical audit, public aggregate summary only
facts.title: Controlled shifts (restricted raw evidence, aggregate report only)
facts.statement: Under the adaptation-timescale shift, nominal 90% conditional coverage falls to 208/256 = 81.25% (parent A step-up/14 squat) and 203/256 = 79.296875% (parent B step-up/28 squat). Conditional reliability is not established.
facts.limits: Restricted raw evidence, aggregate report only: the underlying cohorts, scores and fitted parameters are not public and cannot be reproduced from this repository.
